unchanged_contiguous_spoken_excerpt: A former Google self-driving engineer faced a civil judgment of one hundred seventy-nine million dollars in March 2020. Anthony Levandowski filed for bankruptcy just hours later. This was not his criminal sentence, and it was not a verdict against Uber. The question was whether Uber might have to help pay.
isolated_finding: Does not establish why Uber could have to pay: the Short jumps from engineer's personal judgment to Uber without identifying Otto acquisition/2016 indemnity. Isolated viewers lack causal context.
must_repair_in_longform: Mention Uber's acquisition and indemnity before 'might have to help pay'; then keep distinction civil personal liability / corporate verdict.

unchanged_contiguous_spoken_excerpt: In December 2015, Google engineer Anthony Levandowski downloaded roughly fourteen thousand files from the company's internal self-driving project. Justice Department records say he moved the collection to a personal computer. That documents the copying. It does not establish that Uber later received or used all those files.
isolated_finding: Standalone actor, exact ~14k file count, official DOJ attribution and transfer/use distinction all present.
must_repair_in_longform: Measure actual Harrison delivery; source claim explicitly separate from proof Uber received files.

unchanged_contiguous_spoken_excerpt: Uber's 2016 acquisition of Otto was described with a price potentially reaching about six hundred eighty million dollars. But Delaware court records describe only one hundred thousand dollars in upfront cash, with substantial potential equity tied to future conditions. That headline number was not six hundred eighty million dollars wired to Levandowski.
isolated_finding: Conditional ~$680m deal, $100k upfront, future equity and not-all-cash distinction complete.
must_repair_in_longform: Measure delivery; keep dollar values as qualified potential consideration.

unchanged_contiguous_spoken_excerpt: Uber hired forensic investigators before buying Otto in 2016. Later shareholder allegations described concerns about former Google employees retaining confidential information. isolated_finding: Properly attributes derivative shareholder allegations and limits Stroz report to no discovered transfer evidence.
must_repair_in_longform: Measure delivery; don't convert no evidence of transfer into affirmative innocence.
